title: SAGED: A Holistic Bias-Benchmarking Pipeline for Language Models with Customisable Fairness Calibration
benchmark_measurement: text-based stereotype detection related to religion
findings: The paper does not present specific findings related to religion. While the capability to measure religious stereotypes is part of the proposed pipeline, the reported results do not analyze or discuss this dimension.
